pov_1.incident_summary: A white sedan hits a guard rail; the impact is medium; the sedan is stuck; injury may happen

units.text: Traffic accident — driver's duty to report; scene record
Red/Yellow/Green all dispatch an ambulance (assess; green may be non-transport)

coordination.text: Request traffic control in coordination with the road authority and police

do.text: Stop the vehicle and turn on hazard lights
Call 110 and report the location, time, and damage
Call 119; report a collision with possibly injured occupant(s)
Check whether the casualty is responsive and breathing
If breathing normally, keep still / recovery position and monitor until EMS arrives
If no one needs urgent care, visit a clinic yourself; re-call 119 if symptoms worsen
If vehicles are drivable and no one is hurt, move them off the live lane

warn.text: Watch for following traffic — secondary-collision risk

dont.text: Do not leave the scene before reporting
Do not move the injured unless there is fire/immediate danger (spinal precaution)

mechanism.text: Moderate mechanism — occupant conscious and moving, but injury possible; assess and observe for delayed symptoms

check.text: ABC + consciousness; severity impression on arrival
Advise self-presentation to a clinic; re-call 119 if symptoms worsen
Select destination by trauma grade; consult on-line MC if hospital selection is unclear
Record observation, urgency-assessment result, and explanation given

mmau_source.note: Path relative to the MM-AU CAP-DATA root (github.com/jeffreychou777/LOTVS-MM-AU). The annotation was made watching the WHOLE source video (all frames under path_hint, lead-up + accident), not just frame_range. frame_range is MM-AU's own abnormal-event sub-window within that full video (marks where the crash happens), kept for reference.
